_about: Blind panel rounds that collected 2 or more replies and never got their JOINT round. Star topology is 2 halves and only the first was run. Produced by scripts/the_joint_round_was_almost_never_run_2026-10-08.py; enforced by bench/tests/test_a_blind_round_has_a_joint_round_2026-10-08.py, which refuses a NEW blind round while any entry here is still OWED. An entry records a debt; it does not forgive one.
_why: FOUNDER, 2026-10-08: "you don't seem to have been running recent panels under star topology, blind run first?" Measured: 15 of 99 rounds with 2 or more landed replies have a joint round, 0.151515, Wilson [0.094023, 0.235041]. Since his ruling of 2026-10-06 that the topology be unskippable, 1 of 5, Wilson [0.036224, 0.624465]. The 4 unpaired rounds since the ruling were all dispatched by CC1 and all reported to him as star topology.
_the_rule: A joint round is OWED by every blind round with 2 or more landed replies. The debt is discharged by running the joint round, or by a later round whose brief SUBSUMES the question -- never by deleting the entry.

status_meanings.OWED: the joint round has not been run and nothing supersedes it
status_meanings.SUPERSEDED: a named later round asks the same question and carries the joint half
status_meanings.DISCHARGED: the joint round was run; names it
